text:
1. **Scope creep — entire PR beyond the stated fix** (new files: `ShortcutsHelp.tsx`, tab-switch shortcuts in `Navbar.tsx`/`store/shortcuts.ts`, i18n key removals/renames across all locale files; `PR_TEMPLATE.md` added to repo root). None of this is described in the PR title/description ("Fix mini-app cache issue when switching navigation modes"). This should be rejected and split out — a cache bugfix PR must not also rewrite the shortcuts settings UI and i18n keys. Fix: strip everything except the `MinAppPage.tsx` change (and its test) from this PR.

2. **`src/renderer/src/i18n/locales/*.json` — existing i18n keys deleted/renamed without migration**: `settings.shortcuts.*` keys like `title`, `show_settings`, `mini_window`, `search_message`, `zoom_in/out/reset`, `exit_fullscreen`, etc. are removed and replaced with new `category.*`/`no_results` keys, but `label.ts`'s `shortcutKeyMap` and the actual Settings → Shortcuts page still reference the old keys (e.g. `settings.shortcuts.title`, `show_settings`) for the existing shortcuts table. This breaks the existing shortcuts settings page (untranslated/missing strings) for every locale. Fix: do not delete existing keys; only add new ones needed by the new component, in `en-us.json`/`zh-cn.json` first per i18n workflow, and never hand-edit `translate/*.json` auto-generated locales.

3. **`translate/*.json` locale files manually edited with `[to be translated]:` placeholders and raw Chinese text** (el-gr, es-es, fr-fr, ja-jp, pt-pt, ru-ru). These are typically machine-generated/synced files in this repo's i18n pipeline (per `yarn` i18n scripts), not meant for direct hand edits introducing literal Chinese strings into e.g. Greek/Spanish locale files. This will conflict with the i18n sync tooling and ship untranslated text to users. Fix: revert all `translate/*.json` and `locales/zh-tw.json` edits; let the i18n pipeline generate them from the en-us/zh-cn source.

4. **`PR_TEMPLATE.md` added at repo root, duplicating PR description** — not a real template (it's this specific PR's description), wrong location/purpose, pollutes repo root. Fix: remove the file entirely.

5. **`MinAppPage.tsx` — early-return `if (!app || !isTopNavbar) return null` now reruns on every `isTopNavbar` toggle**, meaning when switching from top to sidebar nav while a tab is open, the component unmounts immediately without any cleanup/unregistration from `TabsService`/keep-alive cache, differing from previous "captured once at mount" semantics. Need to verify no stale tab/cache entries are left registered in `TabsService` when this unmount happens mid-session. Fix: add/verify cleanup (e.g., `useEffect` cleanup to deregister from cache) when `isTopNavbar` flips from true to false while mounted, and add a test for that transition specifically (not just mount-time behavior).

6. **`Navbar.tsx` — new `switchToTab` writes directly into `tabs` state via `setActiveTab(tabs[index].id)` using fixed numeric indices 1–9**, bound unconditionally even when `showAssistants`/other modal UI (e.g. the new `ShortcutsHelpContext`, input fields) has focus — standard numeric-shortcut conventions in this app (and most apps) should not fire while an input/textarea is focused. No guard against this is present. Fix: guard `useShortcut` handlers to no-op when focus is in an editable element, consistent with other shortcut handlers in the codebase (check `useShortcut`/`useShortcuts` for existing conventions before adding unguarded global bindings).

7. **Duplicate import line in `Navbar.tsx`**: `import ShortcutsHelpContainer from '...'` and `import { ShortcutsHelpService } from '...'` are two separate import statements from the same module — should be merged into one import statement per the project's lint/import-order conventions. Fix: `import ShortcutsHelpContainer, { ShortcutsHelpService } from '@renderer/components/ShortcutsHelp/ShortcutsHelp'`.

8. **`ShortcutsHelp.tsx` — categorization logic uses fragile `string.includes()` matching on shortcut keys** (e.g. `s.key.includes('show')` would also match `show_shortcuts_help` itself, `show_app`, etc., miscategorizing as "navigation" when intent may differ) and uses `any[]` typing for `renderShortcutCategory`/`shortcuts` parameters, bypassing the `Shortcut` type already defined in `@renderer/types`. Fix: use the typed `Shortcut[]`, and replace substring matching with an explicit category map keyed by shortcut key.
